sections.title: GAIN AND MAINTAIN MUSCLE MASS
sections.content: Protein contributes to the growth of muscle mass [1]. The amino acids it contains are essential for the synthesis of muscle proteins. When the body receives an adequate amount of this building block, it provides the raw materials needed for muscle growth.

sections.title: HEALTHY BONES
sections.content: Protein intake helps maintain healthy bones [2]. Bones are made up of cells, proteins, minerals and other substances. Protein is essential for the formation of new cells, including those involved in building and maintaining bone structure.

sections.title: DIET AND TRAINING SUPPORT
sections.content: Protein is the foundation of a properly functioning body. Its universal role makes it indispensable in almost all life processes, without which we could not function.  For the average adult, it is recommended to consume about 0.8 g of protein per kilogram of body weight. However, it is worth remembering that people who train intensively and seniors have an increased need for this macronutrient, which results from their regenerative and metabolic needs. A varied diet that provides all the necessary amino acids allows you to fully utilise the potential of protein, contributing to optimal health and performance.

longDescription.conclusion: WHEY PROTEIN - the most popular protein supplement for bigger muscles and healthy bones!
